sources.label: S1
sources.title: Copy Requests: Statements, Debit or Credit Items, and Account Documentation - PR2306
sources.text: Do not:Fax, email, or mail statement copies directly to a third-party (individuals or entities) without transaction authority on the specified account. Note: One-time requests to fax statements are not permitted Fax the following statement or transaction information to customers:Copies of statements printed from OIB or MARS SVP Checking or Savings Account History screen prints Form 100, 120, 200, 300, 400, and 500 statements Provide copies of customer statements to Cayman Bank Home Mortgage Consultants (HMCs). Refer HMCs to their current process guides for information on obtaining general account information.

sources.label: S2
sources.title: Copy Requests: Statements, Debit or Credit Items, and Account Documentation - PR2306
sources.text:
Never encourage or suggest a customer to share online banking credentials with others to access account information.
Do not accept customer requests to email or mail account information directly to third-party individuals or entities without transaction authority on the requested account.
Requests for account information may be verbally communicated to the customer or a printed copy may be provided.
